supersedes: artifacts/outreach/v6-runtime-ledger-read-powerhouse-20261002.json (the manual V6 read: the preflight now performs the exact production ledger read itself, in-process, and consumes it directly)
purpose: Run PROSPECT_PREFLIGHT for the Powerhouse fixture against the live production ledgers. There is nothing to paste back: the route reads suppressions, prospects, outbound reservations/events and replies itself, compiles a digest-bound contact-history receipt in-process, re-runs the deterministic intake, the V5 tournament and the effect-package compiler, and returns one typed state.
precondition: The route exists only once a build containing /api/prospect-preflight is deployed. Verify the deployed SHA first; a 404 means the build predates it, never "clean".

request.authentication: Owner admin bearer token, supplied by the authenticated caller. Never recorded, never committed. The route returns 503 when no admin token is configured and 401 without it.

recipient.excerpt: Also available to non-clients – just email hello@mypowerhouse.group for more information!

pagesChecked: targeted indexed searches for harvest / solicitation / scrape / address-collection restrictions

unsupportedPatterns.reason: no evidence Sylvester after-hours rules live in ServiceTitan

expectedStatesToday.note: With the placeholders still unresolved the best reachable state is BLOCKED_IDENTITY (or BLOCKED_SENDER_HEALTH if the fleet allocator returns no healthy mailbox). DO_NOT_SEND with prior-contact-or-suppression-runtime-ledger-hit means a production hit exists and Powerhouse is rejected with that exact reason. BLOCKED_CONTACT_HISTORY means a ledger could not be read: that is never clean.
neverReturned: READY_FOR_AUTHORIZATION without a final owner-supplied identity and resolved sender-side legal authority

forbidden: treating a 404, a timeout or a partial read as clean
freshness: The recipient evidence is checked against the cold-route 7-day maximum; if it has aged out the preflight returns BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_FACT with cold-route-evidence-stale and the observation must be re-fetched.
